nodes.question: What is spent potlining (SPL) and how much is generated for every metric ton of aluminum produced?
nodes.answer: Spent potlining (SPL) is the worn-out cathode lining from aluminum production, and it is estimated that approximately 25 kg of SPL is generated for every metric ton of aluminum produced.
nodes.paragraph: The worn-out cathode lining is termed as spent potlining (SPL). It is estimated that ca. 25 kg of SPL is generated for everymetric ton aluminum produced. [7]however, this number can vary between aluminum producing industrial sites depending on the lifetime of the cells, the design, the degree of cleaning before and sorting while deconstruct-ing a spent cell, and the degree of reuse of the steel casing. The estimated global yearly production of SPL was around 1.42 million metric tons in 2020 and theestimated forecast in 2050 is 1.85 million metric tons.
